_comment: ROW 774 -- the login submit sweep accepted any page.url change as a submit, so bang.com's text-matched LOGIN WITH GOOGLE button (-> accounts.google.com) read as a login. Every anchor is ZERO-WIDTH on a code line: the origin equality, _settle's acceptance, each of the three observation sites (pre-check, post-click poll, post-networkidle poll), and do_login's declared-origin acceptance (the flow flag and the declared set). The transform control is in its own file beside this one and MUST escape.
subject: a submit is a SAME-ORIGIN navigation (interstitial._origin) at all three observation sites, and do_login accepts a foreign final origin only when the site declared it

mutants.label: M1 the origin predicate is inverted (only a FOREIGN origin counts as a submit)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        if origin is not None and origin)(?===initial_origin: return True$)
mutants.new: is not None and not origin

mutants.label: M2 _settle accepts any URL change (the foreign-origin string is truthy)
M3 the post-click poll site returns True on any move (bypasses _settle)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^            if moved is not None: return )(?=_settle\(moved,label\)\n            try: page\.wait_for_load_state)

mutants.label: M4 the post-networkidle poll site returns True on any move (bypasses _settle)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^            if moved is not None: return )(?=_settle\(moved,label\)\n            time\.sleep\(0\.3\))

mutants.label: M5 the pre-check site returns True on any move (bypasses _settle)
M6 do_login never refuses a foreign final origin
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        if )(?=not _flow_ran and \(cur_origin is None or cur_origin not in declared_origins\):$)

mutants.label: M7 the final origin declares itself (cookie count outranks the origin again)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        declared_origins=\{o for o in \()(?=_origin\(url\), _origin\(success or ""\)\) if o\}$)

mutants.label: M8 every site is treated as having declared a cross-origin flow
M9 same-origin navigation is refused too (only the exact initial URL would pass, which _moved already excluded)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        if origin is not None and origin==initial_origin)(?=: return True$)

mutants.label: M10 a declared flow no longer exempts the final origin (v3.66.302 multi-step logins refused)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^        if )(?=not _flow_ran and \(cur_origin is None or cur_origin not in declared_origins\):$)
